lines.zh: 我在水里慢慢下沉，又浮起。
lines.en: I sink slowly in the water, then rise.

lines.zh: 我的壳在海水里轻轻晃。
lines.en: My shell sways gently in the sea.
I stir the water with my tentacles, slowly.
I circle the seagrass.
I drift over a sandy floor.

lines.zh: 我的壳上有一圈圈的纹。
lines.en: My shell carries ring upon ring of ridges.
The current carries me along.
I turn in a new direction, slowly.
I rise into a higher layer of water.
I slide past the coral.

lines.zh: 我的触手伸出去，又收回。
lines.en: My tentacles reach out and draw back.

lines.zh: 海底的光斑在我壳上晃。
lines.en: Light patches waver on my shell.
I roll over slowly.

lines.zh: 我漂进一片更暗的水里。
lines.en: I drift into darker water.

lines.zh: 我的壳在水里显得很白。
lines.en: My shell looks pale in the water.
I ride a dark current forward.
I hang in the water, turning slowly.
My tentacles hang quietly.
Bubbles rise past my shell.
The water is just the right warmth.
I open my shell mouth slowly.

lines.zh: 小鱼从我身边游过，我不理。
lines.en: Small fish pass; I pay them no mind.
I wait for the current to take me.
A little crab is on my shell.
I draw my tentacles in tight.
The light is dim here. Good.
I rise and fall with the water.
I count the seagrass swaying.

lines.zh: 我的壳里灌了水，刚好悬着。
lines.en: Water in my chambers keeps me suspended.
I have no need to hurry.

lines.zh: 你潜下来了，看得很清楚。
lines.en: You've dived down. I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你的气泡一串串升上去。
lines.en: Your bubbles rise in strings.
I slowly turn to face you.
I'm a very old shell.
Don't touch the opening of my shell.
Your hands look pale in the water.

lines.zh: 我壳上的纹路，一圈就是一年。
lines.en: Each ring on my shell is a year.
Are you going to catch me?
My tentacles will pull in.
Light wavers on your face.
A mark on my shell.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，很久没出来。
lines.en: I pull in and stay a long while.
A little of my color in the water.

lines.zh: 壳唇崩了一角，海水渗进来。
lines.en: A chip breaks off my shell lip and seawater seeps in.
I sink slowly and go still.
My shell knocked askew; I spin half a turn.
My shell won't close tight.
My coiled shell rolled over.
The water has gone cloudy.
I need a rock crevice to hide in.
Those crumbs are within reach.

lines.zh: 你把手伸下来，我慢了一步。
lines.en: You reach down, and I'm a beat late.
The taste in the water is strong.
I rise a little, slowly.
It's not much to me.
I reach my tentacles that way.
What are you waiting for up there?
I drift toward your hand.
The sea brings the scent.
Just a foot nearer as I drift.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的壳，我晃了晃。
lines.en: You touch my shell and I rock.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地退开，触手收紧。
lines.en: I draw back, tentacles closing.

lines.zh: 水流把我和你撞在一起。
lines.en: The current knocks us together.
My shell is hard. Don't knock it.

lines.zh: 你推了我一下，我飘出去。
lines.en: You push and I drift away.
I roll, shell mouth down.

lines.zh: 我的触手碰到你的手指。
lines.en: My tentacles touch your fingers.
We drift apart in the water.

lines.zh: 你踩到海底的沙，我就在旁边。
lines.en: You stir the sand, and I'm right there.
That touch kept me drawn in for a while.
Another shell drifts near.
Our shells touch.
Its spiral is tighter than mine.
We sink side by side.

lines.zh: 触手在水里碰到了一起。
lines.en: Our tentacles meet in the water.
Its shell is older than mine.
We drift with the current together.
The seafloor is quiet but for us.
We don't speak, and needn't.

lines.zh: 这片海域，以后有两只了。
lines.en: There will be two shells in this sea now.

lines.zh: 我用触手卷住一点东西。
lines.en: I curl a tentacle around something.
I bring the crumbs to my shell's mouth.

lines.zh: 这东西沉不下去，我拖着。
lines.en: It won't sink; I drag it along.
I wrap it slowly.

lines.zh: 有东西落在海底，我捡了。
lines.en: Something fell to the floor; I take it.

lines.zh: 触手卷起一粒发亮的沙。
lines.en: My tentacles curl around a glittering grain of sand.
This one is bright.
I take a little. It's ordinary.
It's mine. Don't dive after it.
I slowly push it underneath.
You mean to pry my shell open.
I draw my tentacles in.
The water has cooled a little.
I sink to the seafloor.

lines.zh: 你潜下来，气泡先暴露了你。
lines.en: You dive in, but your bubbles give you away.
My shell's mouth is closed.
I'm here, and can't avoid you.
You haven't dived deep enough.
The seafloor sand will hide me.

lines.zh: 我把壳口转向你，触手缩紧。
lines.en: I turn my shell opening your way, tentacles drawn in.
I know these weeds well.
If you'd catch me, be quick.

lines.zh: 我一点儿一点儿往下沉。
lines.en: I settle down bit by bit.
Shadows are hard to read underwater.
I slide behind the coral.
You're above; I'm below.

lines.zh: 水流会把我的位置藏住。
lines.en: The current hides my position.

lines.zh: 我的壳是螺旋的，三叠纪的款式。
lines.en: My shell is a spiral, Triassic style.
I shift a little along the floor.

lines.zh: 我的壳和石头一个颜色。
lines.en: My shell is the color of stone.
When you look, I'm not there.
No hurry. I outlast you.
I rise slowly again.

lines.zh: 这片海底我熟得闭眼都行。
lines.en: I know this floor blind.
Your hand is slow in the water.

lines.zh: 我的触手缠住你的手指。
lines.en: My tentacles wrap your fingers.
I knock your hand's back.
There's almost no force in that.
You push me away.
I pull into my shell, quick.
I roll once on the bottom.
You reach again; I draw in again.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的护腕上，弹开。
lines.en: I bounce off your bracer.
I sink another stretch toward the floor.
Inside the shell you can't reach me.
I wait in the weeds for you to let go.
That's the best I can do.
The seafloor sand stirs.
I float out from behind the coral.
A new shadow joins the water.
My shell catches the light in the dark.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地沉到这片海底。
lines.en: I settle slowly onto this seafloor.
A string of bubbles rises first.
I drift into the shallows.

lines.zh: 我的螺旋壳从海草里滚出来。
lines.en: My spiral shell rolls out of the seagrass.

lines.zh: 我在这里找到一块石头。
lines.en: I've found a stone here.
The weeds sway; I've arrived.
I slowly unfold my tentacles.
The current brought me here.
I sink and settle on the sand.

lines.zh: 光从水面上落下来，照着我。
lines.en: Light falls from the surface onto me.

lines.zh: 水被烧热了，我的壳发烫。
lines.en: The water heats and my shell burns.

lines.zh: 我从水面上掉下来，撞在石上。
lines.en: I fall from the surface and hit stone.

lines.zh: 我本该在水里，可这水不让我呼吸。
lines.en: I belong in water, yet this water won't let me breathe.

lines.zh: 爆风把我从海底掀了起来。
lines.en: The blast lifts me off the seafloor.

lines.zh: 一枚东西打在我的壳上，弹开了。
lines.en: Something strikes my shell and bounces off.

lines.zh: 法术让水压下来，我动不了。
lines.en: That spell presses the water down; I can't move.
There's nothing to eat in this sea.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我整个壳都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and my shell numbs.

lines.zh: 水退走了，我的壳往下坠。
lines.en: The water withdraws and my shell drops.
